questions.question: What is a rational function?
choices: Any function containing a square root
A quotient of polynomials with denominator not identically zero
A function with only whole-number outputs

questions.question: What input is excluded from f(x) = 1/(x + 3)?
Which line is the vertical asymptote of f(x) = 1/(x − 2)?
Which line is the horizontal asymptote of f(x) = 1/x?
What is a hole in a rational graph?
choices: A zero that every graph must include
A missing point caused by a canceled denominator factor
A point where the graph reaches its maximum

questions.question: Which denominator determines the domain restriction of a rational expression?
What is f(2) for f(x) = 3/x?
For f(x) = (x² − 1)/(x − 1), why is x = 1 still excluded after simplification?
choices: The simplified expression x + 1 is zero there
Every canceled factor creates a new domain value
The original denominator is zero there

questions.question: What is the hole location in f(x) = (x² − 1)/(x − 1)?
What is the horizontal asymptote of f(x) = (2x + 1)/(x − 4)?
Why does f(x) = 1/(x − 2) have a vertical asymptote at 2 rather than a hole?
choices: Its horizontal asymptote is not zero
Its denominator factor does not cancel with the numerator

questions.question: What is the x-intercept of f(x) = (x − 3)/(x + 1)?
What is the y-intercept value of f(x) = (x − 3)/(x + 1)?
Which statement about horizontal asymptotes is correct?
choices: A rational graph can cross a horizontal asymptote
A graph can never cross any horizontal asymptote
Every rational function has y = 0 as its asymptote
A horizontal asymptote excludes its y-value from every graph

questions.question: If a rational function's numerator degree is smaller than its denominator degree, what is its horizontal asymptote?
choices: It always has no horizontal asymptote

questions.question: The function f(x) = x/(x² + 1) has horizontal asymptote y = 0. Which point shows that it crosses that line?
For f(x) = (x − 2)/[(x − 2)(x + 3)], what occurs at x = 2 and x = −3 respectively?
choices: A hole and a vertical asymptote
A vertical asymptote and a hole

questions.question: Which line is the horizontal asymptote of f(x) = 5 + 2/x?
As x approaches 0 from the positive side in f(x) = 1/x, what happens to f(x)?
A student cancels x from (x + 1)/x and claims the graph is y = 2. What is the valid correction?
choices: The function is x + 1 for all real x
